info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector Describe API

params.name: maxCandidates
params.description: Maximum number of candidate descriptions to be returned.  The default is 1.

params.name: language
params.description: The desired language for output generation. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is "en".Supported languages:en - English, Default. es - Spanish, ja - Japanese, pt - Portuguese, zh - Simplified Chinese.

items.docs: This operation generates a description of an image in human readable language with complete sentences.  The description is based on a collection of content tags, which are also returned by the operation. More than one description can be generated for each image.  Descriptions are ordered by their confidence score. All descriptions are in English.
